newsitem.title: USA: California marijuana advocate wants to be governor.
newsitem.headline: California marijuana advocate wants to be governor.

text.p: Dennis Peron, the flamboyant founder of a San Francisco club that supplies marijuana to the sick, plans to run for California governor as a Republican, a spokesman said Wednesday.
Peron wants to challenge his arch-enemy, state Attorney General Dan Lungren, in the Republican primary in 1998, Peron's assistant, John Entwistle, said.
"His hat's in the ring," Entwistle said. Declaring his candidacy was "a formality," he said. "He's going to do it."
Lungren, a former member of Congress, has raised $2.5 million for a run for governor and is seen as an overwhelming favourite to capture the Republican nomination.
Peron, a gay Vietnam veteran, founded the San Francisco Cannabis Cultivators' Club, which supplies marijuana to about 6,000 people suffering from AIDS, cancer and other illnesses.

He also helped draft a California ballot measure permitting sick people to smoke marijuana to ease their pain. The controversial measure, called Proposition 215, was passed by state voters last November.
Lungren, a law and order hardliner, has been Peron's nemesis, opposing Proposition 215 and ordering a crackdown last year on Peron's club, which at that time operated in defiance of the law.

Lungren won a court order closing Peron's club last August, and in October Peron was arrested by state narcotics agents on a charge of possessing marijuana for sale. He has yet to be tried. A San Francisco judge allowed the club to re-open in January.
Entwistle said Peron registered a few months ago as a Republican. He said Peron had a high profile and planned to run a grassroots campaign. "This campaign is about hope," Entwistle said.

He said the contest would present a "contrast in values" between Peron, who focuses on social causes, and Lungren, who he described as "basically a zealot." He said Peron had "a lot of life experience", having returned from Vietnam a pacifist.

The San Francisco Chronicle quoted Lungren Wednesday as dismissing Peron's candidacy. "If Dennis Peron is running for governor on the Republican ticket, he has smoked more marijuana than even I thought," he was quoted as saying.
